name: Memory Sharing & Fusion
description: Give every AI agent the same memory. Preferences remembered by Codex carry over to Claude; work left unfinished yesterday can be picked up by any agent today.

zh-CN.name: Memory Sharing & Fusion
zh-CN.description: 给你的每一个 AI Agent 同一份记忆。Codex 记住的偏好，Claude 接着用；昨天做到一半的工作，今天任何 Agent 接着做。
